datasetMetadata.name: Sample Online Learning Data
datasetMetadata.description: Comprehensive course catalog, instructor profiles, student enrollments, lessons, and quiz assessments modeled after Kaggle benchmark datasets.

courses.title: Full-Stack Web Development Bootcamp 2026
courses.shortDescription: Master HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and MongoDB by building 10 real-world production projects.
courses.description: Become a full-stack web developer with this comprehensive, hands-on curriculum. This course takes you from absolute beginner with zero coding background to confidently deploying production applications. You will learn modern JavaScript (ES6+), responsive layout techniques with CSS Grid and Flexbox, state management in React, RESTful API design with Express and Node.js, and database schema modeling with MongoDB.
learningOutcomes: Build full-stack web applications using the MERN stack
Implement secure JWT authentication and role-based access control
Design scalable RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express
Work with MongoDB and Mongoose for schema validation and indexing
Deploy full-stack applications to modern cloud platforms
requirements: A computer with internet access (Windows, Mac, or Linux)
No prior coding experience required; we start from scratch

lessons.title: Introduction to Web Architecture & Client-Server Model
lessons.description: Understand how the web works: HTTP requests, DNS resolution, servers, and modern web clients.

lessons.title: Modern JavaScript (ES6+) Fundamentals & Asynchronous Programming
lessons.description: Arrow functions, destructuring, promises, async/await, and event loop architecture.

lessons.title: React Component Architecture, Hooks & State Flow
lessons.description: Building interactive user interfaces using useState, useEffect, custom hooks, and context.

lessons.title: Backend Engineering: Node.js, Express & REST APIs
lessons.description: Creating robust Express server endpoints, route handlers, middleware, and request validation.

lessons.title: Database Integration with MongoDB & Mongoose ORM
lessons.description: Connecting MongoDB, defining Mongoose schemas, relationships, and performing CRUD queries.

quiz.title: Full-Stack Web Foundations Assessment
quiz.description: Test your grasp on client-server architecture, modern JavaScript, and React mechanics.

questions.questionText: What does the 'M' in the MERN stack stand for?
questions.explanation: MERN stands for MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is conventionally used to update an existing resource partially or completely?
questions.explanation: PUT is used for full replacement or update, while PATCH applies partial updates to a resource.

questions.questionText: In React, what hook is primarily used to perform side effects such as data fetching?
questions.explanation: useEffect lets you synchronize a component with an external system such as APIs or event listeners.

questions.questionText: How does Node.js handle asynchronous non-blocking I/O operations?
options: By allocating a new physical OS thread for every single connection
Using a single-threaded Event Loop with libuv thread pool
By forcing all synchronous blocking operations to execute first
Node.js does not support asynchronous operations
questions.explanation: Node.js uses an event-driven, single-threaded event loop powered by libuv for asynchronous I/O.

courses.title: Deep Learning & Machine Learning with Python
courses.shortDescription: Train neural networks, convolutional networks, and transformers using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-Learn.
courses.description: Comprehensive journey through modern Artificial Intelligence. Learn regression, classification, clustering, followed by deep artificial neural networks, convolutional neural networks for computer vision, and recurrent architectures. Includes practical real-world Kaggle datasets.
learningOutcomes: Implement supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms
Build and optimize multi-layer neural networks
Understand backpropagation, loss functions, and gradient descent optimizers
Develop computer vision models using CNNs
Evaluate model performance with ROC-AUC, precision, recall, and F1-score
requirements: High school level linear algebra and calculus

lessons.title: Foundations of Machine Learning & Model Evaluation
lessons.description: Train-test splitting, cross-validation, bias-variance tradeoff, and evaluation metrics.

lessons.title: Gradient Descent & Backpropagation from Scratch
lessons.description: Mathematical derivation and Python implementation of neural network learning.

lessons.title: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for Image Recognition
lessons.description: Kernels, feature maps, pooling layers, and building vision classifiers.

lessons.title: Transformers & Attention Mechanism Deep Dive
lessons.description: Self-attention mechanism, multi-head attention, and transformer encoder-decoder layers.

quiz.title: Neural Networks & Machine Learning Core Quiz
quiz.description: Validate your understanding of machine learning principles and neural architectures.

questions.questionText: What problem does the ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit) activation function help mitigate compared to Sigmoid?
questions.explanation: ReLU does not saturate for positive values, preventing gradients from vanishing during backpropagation.

questions.questionText: Which metric is most informative when evaluating a model on an extremely imbalanced classification dataset?
questions.explanation: Accuracy can be deceptively high by always predicting the majority class; F1-score and Precision-Recall AUC balance sensitivity and precision.

questions.questionText: What is the primary role of a pooling layer in a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)?
options: Downsample spatial dimensions to reduce parameters and computation
questions.explanation: Pooling layers downsample the feature maps, reducing spatial size and translation sensitivity.

courses.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner & Solutions Architect
courses.shortDescription: Master Amazon Web Services: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, Lambda, RDS, and CloudFront with hands-on architectural labs.
courses.description: Design fault-tolerant, highly available, and scalable cloud architectures on AWS. Prepare for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate exam with real architecture diagrams, IAM security best practices, multi-AZ deployment, serverless computing with AWS Lambda, and managed databases.
learningOutcomes: Design scalable, highly available architectures on AWS
Configure Virtual Private Clouds (VPC), Subnets, and Security Groups
Implement serverless microservices with AWS Lambda & API Gateway
Secure cloud infrastructure using IAM policies and encryption at rest/transit
requirements: Basic understanding of computers and networking (IP addresses, ports)
Free tier AWS account for practice labs

lessons.title: Cloud Computing Essentials & AWS Global Infrastructure
lessons.description: Regions, Availability Zones, Edge Locations, and shared responsibility model.

lessons.title: Identity and Access Management (IAM) Best Practices
lessons.description: Users, groups, roles, policies, MFA, and least-privilege security principle.

lessons.title: Compute: EC2, Auto-Scaling Groups & Elastic Load Balancers
lessons.description: Deploying virtual instances, configuring health checks, and automatic horizontal scaling.

lessons.title: Networking: Building a Secure VPC with Public & Private Subnets
lessons.description: Internet Gateways, Route Tables, NAT Gateways, and Network ACLs.

quiz.title: AWS Cloud Architecture Certification Quiz
quiz.description: Assess your understanding of AWS infrastructure, security, and networking concepts.

questions.questionText: According to the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, what is the customer responsible for in EC2?
options: Guest operating system patches, application code, and firewall configurations
questions.explanation: Security OF the cloud is AWS's responsibility, while security IN the cloud (OS patches, application logic, data) is the customer's responsibility.

questions.questionText: Which service allows instances in a private subnet to initiate outbound internet connections without being reached from the internet?
questions.explanation: A NAT (Network Address Translation) Gateway enables instances in private subnets to reach out for software updates while preventing unsolicited inbound traffic.

questions.questionText: Which Amazon S3 storage class is best suited for data accessed less than once a month with millisecond retrieval requirement?
questions.explanation: S3 Standard-IA offers lower storage costs for infrequently accessed data while retaining immediate millisecond access.

courses.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals: Ethical Hacking & Defense
courses.shortDescription: Learn penetration testing, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, network scanning, cryptography, and defense.
courses.description: Understand modern threat actors and how to defend computer systems and web applications against them. Covers Kali Linux, Nmap, Wireshark, SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), CSRF, cryptographic hashing, and incident response fundamentals.
learningOutcomes: Detect and patch OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities in web applications
Perform reconnaissance and port scanning using Nmap
Analyze captured network packets with Wireshark
Implement secure password hashing using bcrypt/Argon2
requirements: Willingness to learn ethical, defensive security techniques

lessons.title: Threat Modeling, CIA Triad & Fundamentals of Ethical Hacking
lessons.description: Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, defense-in-depth, and attack lifecycle.

lessons.title: Network Analysis & Packet Inspection with Wireshark
lessons.description: Deep packet analysis, TCP handshakes, TLS negotiation, and discovering plaintext leaks.

lessons.title: Web Security: Defeating SQL Injection & Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
lessons.description: Parameterized queries, prepared statements, input sanitization, and Content Security Policy.

quiz.title: Cybersecurity Defenses Assessment
quiz.description: Test your knowledge of web attack vectors and hardening methodologies.

questions.questionText: What is the primary method to prevent SQL Injection in database queries?
questions.explanation: Parameterized queries separate SQL code from user-supplied data, ensuring untrusted input is treated strictly as literal data.

questions.questionText: In the CIA Triad, what does 'Integrity' mean?
options: Data is only accessible to paying subscribers
Data is accurate, trustworthy, and protected from unauthorized modification
Systems are always available 99.999% of the time
Servers are hosted in multiple geographical regions
questions.explanation: Integrity guarantees that information has not been tampered with or altered by unauthorized parties.

courses.title: Data Science & Big Data Analytics with Pandas & SQL
courses.shortDescription: Extract actionable business insights using Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and SQL.
courses.description: Step into the high-demand field of data science. Learn data wrangling, missing data imputation, exploratory data analysis (EDA), statistical hypothesis testing, and interactive dashboard visualization using real Kaggle datasets.
learningOutcomes: Clean, reshape, and aggregate messy datasets using Pandas
Write complex SQL queries with window functions and subqueries
Create publication-quality visualizations using Seaborn and Matplotlib
Conduct statistical hypothesis testing (t-test, ANOVA, chi-square)
requirements: No prior statistics or programming experience required
Free install of Anaconda / Jupyter Notebooks

lessons.title: Data Manipulation and Indexing with Pandas DataFrames
lessons.description: Loading CSV/JSON datasets, series indexing, slicing, filtering, and group-by aggregations.

lessons.title: Advanced SQL: Window Functions, CTEs & Multi-table Joins
lessons.description: Writing analytical SQL queries to answer high-stakes business questions.

lessons.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) & Data Storytelling
lessons.description: Distributions, correlation heatmaps, box plots, and detecting outliers.

quiz.title: Data Science & Analytical SQL Quiz
quiz.description: Assess your skills in data transformation, aggregation, and query analysis.

questions.questionText: In SQL, what is the key difference between WHERE and HAVING clauses?
options: WHERE filters individual rows before grouping; HAVING filters aggregated groups after GROUP BY
HAVING is only valid in MySQL
WHERE can only be used with primary keys
There is no difference; they are aliases
questions.explanation: WHERE filters rows before aggregation occurs, whereas HAVING filters groups produced by GROUP BY.

questions.questionText: In Pandas, which method is used to replace missing (NaN) values with a specified value or statistical measure?
questions.explanation: df.fillna() replaces null/NaN values with a specified scalar or interpolated value.

courses.title: Modern UI/UX Design with Figma: From Wireframe to Prototype
courses.shortDescription: Create modern, accessible, responsive mobile and web interfaces with Figma design systems.
courses.description: Master Figma from scratch. Learn typography scales, color theory, spacing systems, Auto Layout 5.0, design tokens, interactive prototyping, micro-interactions, and design-to-code developer handoff.
learningOutcomes: Design responsive web and mobile layouts using Auto Layout
Build scalable design systems with reusable components and variants
Create interactive clickable prototypes with smart animations
Ensure WCAG contrast accessibility in modern digital products
requirements: Curiosity for visual aesthetics and user behavior

lessons.title: Figma Workspace, Vector Tools & Layout Grids
lessons.description: Frames, groups, responsive layout grids, and keyboard productivity shortcuts.

lessons.title: Auto Layout, Constraints & Responsive Components
lessons.description: Nesting Auto Layout containers, flex-like behavior, and responsive resizing.

quiz.title: UI/UX & Design Systems Assessment
quiz.description: Test your grasp on typography, layout hierarchy, and Figma component mechanics.

questions.questionText: What is the primary benefit of using Figma Component Variants?
options: Reduce file storage size on Figma servers
Combine similar components (like button states: hover, active, disabled) into a single organized master component
Automatically export code into React Native
Disable CSS animations in the browser
questions.explanation: Variants group multiple variations of the same component under one master component for clean switching.
